title: The same CALCULATE inside a measure sees the row: the measure's own transition comes first
query: DEFINE MEASURE Sales[Color sales] = CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], ALL ( 'Product' ), VALUES ( 'Product'[Color] ) )

source.quote: when you invoke a measure from a DAX expression, this is automatically surrounded by CALCULATE
source.supports: the measure reference is wrapped in a CALCULATE that performs the transition before the measure's body is evaluated

source.quote: VALUES evaluates the values of a column as visible in the current filter context, and applies the result as a filter
source.supports: VALUES gives the values visible in the current filter context and applies them as a filter after ALL removed the filters on Product

derivation: The implicit CALCULATE around [Color sales] filters Product[Product] to the current product. Inside, VALUES ( Product[Color] ) is evaluated in that context: Bike -> Red, Helmet -> Red, Lock -> Blue, Scooter -> Green. ALL ( Product ) removes the product filter and the color filter applies: Red 460 (rows 1, 2, 3, 5, 7), Blue 80 (rows 4, 6), Green no sales, BLANK.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
